whyItMatters: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
actions: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm conan.lock no longer carries a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
